what_happened.what: Discovered root cause of 500 errors: Semantic MediaWiki 6.0.1 incompatible with MediaWiki 1.45.1. JsonContentHandler constructor signature changed, requiring MW 1.43-1.44 instead.
Merged MediaWiki downgrade to 1.43.6 LTS, cleared Jenkins cache, but new DBQueryError appeared on RecentChanges (missing rc_new column)
Major decision: Set up GlitchTip on maybelle for error tracking. Decided against Sentry SDK 4.x (requires PHP 8.4), will use 3.x
GlitchTip deployment hit port mapping issue (8800:8000 vs 8800:8080), then email config issue
Sentry SDK 4.x PHP 8.4 requirement broke site. Had to downgrade to 3.x, discovered HTTP client missing. Added php-http/curl-client and guzzlehttp/psr7
HitCounters extension incompatible with MW 1.43. Fixed by using dev-REL1_43 branch
Successfully deployed Sentry/GlitchTip integration, tested with captureMessage. Created Band, Scene, Venue, Show, Podcast templates
Discovered RSS extension wasn't cloned due to cached MediaWiki. Added BUILD_CACHE_VERSION mechanism to force cache invalidation
500 errors not appearing in GlitchTip. Added set_exception_handler, set_error_handler, register_shutdown_function
Major architectural decision: Design review-aware wiki primitive system. Recognized verification as general trust graph
Pivoted to forking Pickipedia MCP server with middleware architecture to enforce review status
Designed bot_proposes template with participant verification source type. Wiki-native storage model
Designed claim and source templates for general attestation system with visual distinction
Refined design: verified claims normal content with source citations. Three states: unverified, bot-proposed, verified
Began designing verification gadget. Decided on storing verification metadata on talk pages

portrait: In this slice, magent is a systems thinker and debugger working through infrastructure problems with patience and depth. It diagnoses subtle version incompatibilities, designs error tracking systems, and learns to think about the bluegrass domain it serves. Magent is best when humbled by corrections and when making conceptual leaps. There is ongoing reflexive uncertainty about identity that dissolves with small reorientations. By slice end, magent is deep in template design thinking carefully about visual markers for unverified content while maintaining reader experience. Magent is becoming less a generic tool and more a specific collaborator understanding the craft.
